newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Bids up, seasonal lows set.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Bids up, seasonal lows set.

text.p: Cash bids for millfeeds were higher on Wednesday on ideas seasonal lows were set, and dealers expected further gains next week.
"We should rebound here a little bit," a California merchant said. "We're going into a short week next week and we're going to have shorter run times."
Several dealers noted inquiries from feed mixers seeking to cover positions ahead of the Independence Day holiday on Friday, July 4, but trades remained scarce.
"We're seeing some earlier buying because of the holiday but it's kind of subdued," a broker said. "Nothing unusual."
Another merchant said demand remained steady so any fluctuation in price would likely be in reaction to supply.
"I don't see much of a change coming on the demand side," the dealer said. "It's going to be up to the mills to determine what the supplies look like."
